digest.component_or_area: CLI command dispatcher and argument parsing
propositions: Eleven near-duplicate CLI verbs consolidate into five golden-path verbs; removed spellings fail with replacement hints via _REMOVED_SPELLINGS registry
resolve_cli signature changes from (argv, tracker) to (argv, tracker, repo_root) and route adapter flips to argv_tracker_root to support --display mode
check unifies check-ac, clarity-check, quality-check into one route with mutually exclusive flags; each handler retains its original signature and is called by check_cli(argv, tracker, repo_root)
list gains --limit parameter applied after sort, and recent_session_logs_state shares ordering via sort_states(logs, '-created')[:limit] for library/CLI/MCP parity
tag/untag verbs deleted; edit --add-tag/--remove-tag already exist and replace them; scripts/retarget_jira_project.py retargeted from subprocess 'untag' to 'edit --remove-tag'
show --field and deps --descendants flags added; _cmd_show prints one-line JSON per field, _cmd_deps prints descendants when flag set, old parsers and handlers deleted
